versions.content: If function FrNm_PnLearningRequest is called on a channel where FrNmDynamicPncToCh annelMappingEnabled is set to TRUE and FrNm is in the Network Mode the FrNm module shall set the Repeat Message Bit and the Partial Network Learning Bit in the CBV to 1 on this channel and change to or restart the Repeat Message State at the end of a NM Re petition Cycle.
